propositions: The test test_precheck_output_schema_accepts_old_and_new_shapes fails deterministically because review_phase is a required schema property.
The old_shape fixture predates change 889 and omits the now-required review_phase field.
The fix adds review_phase set to planning to the old_shape fixture, a test-only change with no production or schema modifications.
The precheck now always emits review_phase, making it correctly required in the schema.
The red main landed via the Rebase-If-Necessary hazard where change 889 was verified on a pre-test base and merged without re-running CI.
The ticket was resolved upstream by commit f2e4247a1 applying the identical fixture fix, so it is closed as duplicate/resolved-elsewhere.
